cohort: Women (N=120) who underwent a cesarean section.
finding: Chewing gum after cesarean section, especially xylitol-containing gum, significantly shortened the time to first bowel sounds and flatus compared to no gum chewing, though differences in time to first defecation were not significant.
followup_time: Observations were taken until first flatus, bowel sounds, and defecation occurred post-cesarean section, with the longest mean time to an outcome being 12.8 hours.
